classification: AI-assisted analyst normalization policy, separate from reported accounting and subject to student review

adjustments.basis: Identified cancellation charge; no future expense or vesting from these awards.
adjustments.challenge: Does not establish that total future compensation falls; replacement incentives or spending may offset it.
adjustments.change_evidence: New compensation commitments or a correction to the cancellation disclosure.

adjustments.basis: Conservative recurring acquisition-cost allowance; do not assume transaction spending disappears while pursuing acquisitions.
adjustments.challenge: Specific completed-deal costs may not recur at the same rate.
adjustments.change_evidence: Deal-level cost schedule separating completed transactions, committed future costs and steady-state overhead.

adjustments.basis: Retain purchased-inventory basis in baseline; no unsupported cash benefit from reversing purchase accounting.
adjustments.challenge: Finite acquisition accounting charge can be separated when the inventory roll-forward is modeled.

fy2025_policy: No operating addback accepted from reviewed evidence. Keep reported EBIT as the conservative operating baseline; bridge out reported taxes and all below-operating items separately. This is a judgment, not proof that every expense recurs.

retained_risks.treatment: Retain downward revenue adjustment; execution overruns are a relevant operating risk, not automatic lost revenue to restore.

retained_risks.locator: Income statement and cash flow statement
retained_risks.treatment: Retain economic costs. Do not capitalize R&D without a complete consistent asset/amortization schedule.
Bridge reported tax out of net income to reach EBIT; do not extrapolate tax benefit or classify its entirety as a quantified one-time item. Model cash taxes and loss usage separately.
Keep owned operations in reported base; consolidated growth is not a clean organic growth estimate. Future acquisition growth requires its purchase cost and financing.
